# BP2 sketches: banners and steps

*Generated by `tools/bp2_steps.py` from `src/bp2/` - exactly what each sketch prints. Don't edit by hand; change the sketch and run the tool again.*

Every sketch: **g** starts (nothing switches before it), **n** applies the next step, **x** = everything off. After each step: NOW LIVE (every output now), then CHECK NOW. Flash with `pio run -e <sketch> -t upload`; monitor on J23. Test points by printed label and TP number (5V TP1, 3V3RF TP2, GND TP3/TP7, TACH TP4, PWM TP5, 12V TP6, 3V3Q TP8, 3V3S TP9, EN TP10, IO0 TP11, BLW- TP12).

## `bp2_15_boot_state` - 15, 16, 17 — first flash, boot state, loads held in reset (Rev Q)

> Drives NOTHING: every load pin is left to the board's pull-ups and pull-downs.
> Test 15: this banner on J23 = flashed and running.
> Test 16 (power off first: U9 in its socket, pin 1 to the notch; four blowers on J12-J15):
>   meter GPIO4-7 and GPIO17 at their pull-down pads to GND (TP3): all ~0V;
>   each gate Q2-Q6 and Q11 to GND (TP3): ~0V; Q7 (blowers) high;
>   J10 pin 1 ~12V, pin 3 ~0V (K1 de-energised);
>   12V (TP6) to BLW- (TP12): 11.5V or more (blowers at full speed); ion generator off.
> Test 17: HOLD RESET (SW1): each gate Q2-Q6, Q11 to GND (TP3) under 0.1V;
>   12V (TP6) to BLW- (TP12) still 11.5V or more. Release: this banner prints again.

*No step list: commands as in the banner.*

## `bp2_18_outputs` - 18 — each output alone (Rev Q). BP test 12 on the Rev Q pins, plus the ion generator.

> Loads (power off while wiring): SSR input on J10 1-2 (NO mains), heater pad + KSD on J10 3-4,
> humidifier fan on J11. Blowers may be on J12-J15 (they run at full speed throughout).
> The ion generator on J16 - BEFORE starting, with NO power: meter its black lead to its case and
> to its needles - both must be OPEN. Record that. Then fit it to J16; it stays OFF until part (e).
> Steps a-d are BP test 12's; meter to GND (TP7) on the power side.

| # | Step | Check now |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | a1. All off, relay de-energised | Meter J10 pin 1 and pin 3 to GND (TP7): pin 1 ~12V, pin 3 ~0V. Heater pad off, fan off |
| 2 | a2. Relay ENERGISED (nothing else on) | K1 CLICKS. J10 pin 1 ~0V, pin 3 ~12V. Pad stays off (Q3/Q11 off) |
| 3 | a3. Relay de-energised again | K1 clicks back. J10 pin 1 ~12V, pin 3 ~0V |
| 4 | b1. Relay energised, heater signal OFF | Meter across the pad (J10 pin 3 to pin 4): ~0V |
| 5 | b2. Heater PWM 1Hz | Across the pad: ~12V and ~0V, changing once a second |
| 6 | b3. Heater PWM 5Hz | Across the pad: a reading between 0 and 12V that flickers (5 Hz) |
| 7 | b4. Heater PWM 10Hz | Across the pad: a steady part-voltage (10 Hz is faster than the meter) |
| 8 | b5. Heater steady ON | Across the pad: ~12V; the pad warms |
| 9 | b6. Relay DE-ENERGISED with the heater signal still ON | K1 clicks. Across the pad: ~0V - no heater feed with the relay off (the interlock) |
| 10 | b7. Heater signal off | Across the pad: ~0V |
| 11 | c1. Relay de-energised, SSR signal OFF | Red on +A1 (J10 pin 1), black on -A2 (J10 pin 2): ~0V |
| 12 | c2. SSR signal ON | +A1 to -A2: ~12V (the SSR's LED lights, if it has one) |
| 13 | c3. Relay ENERGISED with the SSR signal still ON | K1 clicks. +A1 to -A2: ~0V - no SSR feed on the heating side (the interlock) |
| 14 | c4. SSR signal off, relay de-energised | +A1 to -A2: ~0V |
| 15 | d1. Humidifier fan ON | Fan starts cleanly. Across the fan (J11 pin 1 to pin 2): 11.8V or more |
| 16 | d2. Humidifier fan OFF | Fan stops. Across the fan: ~0V |
| 17 | d3. Humidifier fan ON again | Starts cleanly again |
| 18 | d4. Humidifier fan OFF | Fan stops. Across the fan: ~0V |
| 19 | e1. Ion generator OFF | Across J16 (pin 1 to pin 2): ~0V. Nothing from the generator |
| 20 | e2. Ion generator ON | Across J16: ~12V. The generator runs (a faint hiss; ozone smell close to the needles - don't touch them) |
| 21 | e3. Ion generator OFF | Across J16: ~0V. It stops |

## `bp2_19_interlock` - 19 — the interlock with real loads (Rev Q). BP test 13 on the Rev Q pins.

> Loads (power off while wiring): the 12V bulb on J10 3-4 (KSD in series optional for the bulb);
> the mains lamp in the switched extension socket, with its SSR on J10 1-2 (as BP test 13;
> mains wiring per spec 4.10).
> In steps 2-5 BOTH load signals are ON: K1 alone decides which load has a feed.

| # | Step | Check now |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1. All off, relay off | Both lamps off. Q2, Q3, Q11 gates ~0V |
| 2 | 2. BOTH signals ON, relay OFF (cooling side) | ONLY the mains lamp lights; the 12V bulb is off. Then the gates (next line) |
| 3 | 3. BOTH signals ON, relay ON (heating side) | K1 clicks. ONLY the 12V bulb lights; the mains lamp is off. Gates as step 2 |
| 4 | 4. BOTH signals ON, relay OFF again | ONLY the mains lamp again. Gates as step 2 |
| 5 | 5. BOTH signals ON, relay ON again | ONLY the 12V bulb again. Gates as step 2 |
| 6 | 6. All off, relay off | Both lamps off |

## `bp2_20_full_load` - 20 — full load and the 12V rail (Rev Q).

> Loads (power off while wiring): four blowers on J12-J15, heater pad + KSD on J10 3-4, SSR input on
> J10 1-2 (NO mains), humidifier fan on J11, ion generator on J16, plenum fan on J2.
> PSU 12.0V through the 4A fuse into J1. Record the PSU current at every step.
> The heater switches itself off after 5 minutes on; its 5 minutes start again at step 7, for the readings.
> At step 7:  r <volts>  = the R21/R22 drop -> U8's input current (drop / 3.4 ohm), pass at 2.0V or less.

| # | Step | Check now |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1. Baseline: blowers and plenum fan stopped, every output off | Record the PSU current |
| 2 | 2. + Plenum fan 100% | Record the PSU current. The fan runs |
| 3 | 3. + Blowers 100% (all four) | Record the PSU current |
| 4 | 4. + Relay K1 energised (heater still off) | K1 clicks. Record the PSU current |
| 5 | 5. + Heater pad ON | Record the PSU current |
| 6 | 6. + Humidifier fan ON | Record the PSU current |
| 7 | 7. + Ion generator ON, WiFi connecting and transmitting - EVERYTHING ON | Record the PSU current once WiFi shows CONNECTED. Then meter: J1's + pin to 12V (TP6) - 0.1V or less; 12V (TP6) to GND (TP7) - 11.4V or more; 5V (TP1) to GND (TP7) - 4.9-5.1V; across R21/R22 - 2.0V or less (type  r <volts>); C12's + pad to GND (TP7) - above 9.5V. After 2 minutes on, touch Q1, Q3, Q11, U8, D1: warm at most |

## `bp2_21_wifi_rails` - 21 — 3.3V under WiFi (Rev Q). 12V only, no loads.

> 12V only; no loads (blowers, if fitted, run at full speed). An SD card in J22.
> After g: WiFi connect / send 5 s / disconnect, over and over; SD writes back to back; plenum fan 100%.
> Step 1: 3V3RF (TP2) to GND (TP3) on MIN-HOLD for 10 minutes: 3.2V or more.
> Step 2: 3V3Q (TP8) to GND (TP3) on MIN-HOLD for 10 minutes: 3.2V or more.
> No reset in either (the banner would print again). If a scope is to hand: look at TP2 and TP8
> for ringing (if seen: remove C20 or C28 - a bench fix - and tell Claude).

| # | Step | Check now |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1. 3V3RF (TP2) on min-hold, 10 minutes, everything running | Meter 3V3RF (TP2) to GND (TP3) on MIN-HOLD. After 10 minutes record the minimum: 3.2V or more. No reset |
| 2 | 2. 3V3Q (TP8) on min-hold, 10 minutes, everything running | Meter 3V3Q (TP8) to GND (TP3) on MIN-HOLD. After 10 minutes record the minimum: 3.2V or more. No reset |

## `bp2_22_blowers` - 22 — blower voltage (Rev Q). Four blowers on J12-J15.

> Four blowers on J12-J15 (all four: the table is calibrated with all four fitted, 3A.11).
> Each step sets the blower duty (PWM ~100 kHz on GPIO15); meter 12V (TP6) to BLW- (TP12).
> Below about 70 mA total the voltage reads higher than duty x 12V (3A.6) - expected.

| # | Step | Check now |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Blowers 100% | 12V (TP6) to BLW- (TP12): 11.5V or more. Record it. Listen: no ticking or whine |
| 2 | Blowers 90% | Meter 12V (TP6) to BLW- (TP12) and RECORD it with the duty. Listen: no ticking or whine |
| 3 | Blowers 80% | Meter 12V (TP6) to BLW- (TP12) and RECORD it with the duty. Listen: no ticking or whine |
| 4 | Blowers 70% | Meter 12V (TP6) to BLW- (TP12) and RECORD it with the duty. Listen: no ticking or whine |
| 5 | Blowers 60% | Meter 12V (TP6) to BLW- (TP12) and RECORD it with the duty. Listen: no ticking or whine |
| 6 | Blowers 50% | 12V (TP6) to BLW- (TP12): about 6V. Record it. Listen: no ticking or whine |
| 7 | Blowers 40% | Meter 12V (TP6) to BLW- (TP12) and RECORD it with the duty. Listen: no ticking or whine |
| 8 | Blowers 30% | Meter 12V (TP6) to BLW- (TP12) and RECORD it with the duty. Listen: no ticking or whine |
| 9 | Blowers 20% | Meter 12V (TP6) to BLW- (TP12) and RECORD it with the duty. Listen: no ticking or whine |
| 10 | Blowers 10% | Meter 12V (TP6) to BLW- (TP12) and RECORD it with the duty. Listen: no ticking or whine |
| 11 | Blowers 0% (stopped) | 12V (TP6) to BLW- (TP12): ~0V; the blowers stop. Record it |

## `bp2_23_blower_reset` - 23 — blower overshoot on reset (Rev Q). Four blowers on J12-J15.

> Four blowers on J12-J15. Peak-hold meter: diode + 1uF + meter from 12V (TP6) to BLW- (TP12).
> Note 12V (TP6) first. Then, ten times: g (blowers to 50%), wait 5 s, press RESET (SW1).
> After each reset the blowers are at full speed and this banner prints again - type g again.
> Pass: the peak never above 12V (TP6) + 0.5V. Record the highest peak and the count of resets.

*No step list: commands as in the banner.*

## `bp2_24_watchdog` - 24 and 25 — the hardware watchdog (Rev Q), using the firmware's own driver.

> R26 (0R) fitted. Nothing else needed. GPIO1 is an INPUT now: the hardware watchdog is OFF.
> Test 24: g, then  stall  with a stopwatch: ONE reset 1.12-2.4 s later, then this banner again.
>          Then g,  pause , then  stall : NO reset (it says so after 10 s).
> Test 25: g (toggling), then flash this sketch over USB-C:  pio run -e bp2_24_watchdog -t upload
>          Three times; each must complete. (In download mode GPIO1 is undriven: the watchdog is off.)
> Commands: g, stall, pause, resume.

*No step list: commands as in the banner.*

## `bp2_26_sd_power` - 26 — the SD card power switch (Rev Q), using the firmware's own driver.

> A card in J22. Nothing else needed. The card is powered from boot (GPIO39 an input).
> Before step 1: note 3V3Q (TP8) to GND (TP3) at idle - you need it for step 3.
> Meter the card's supply at C53's pad (J22 VDD) to GND (TP3).

| # | Step | Check now |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1. Card ON: mounted and written | C53 (J22 VDD) to GND (TP3): 3.23-3.37V. The write above says OK. Now set the meter to MIN-HOLD on 3V3Q (TP8) ready for step 3 (or keep it on C53 for step 2 first) |
| 2 | 2. Card OFF: SD lines released (inputs), GPIO39 driven HIGH | C53 (J22 VDD) to GND (TP3): UNDER 0.1V. No reset |
| 3 | 3. Card ON again: GPIO39 an input, pull-up off (soft start); remounted and written | C53 to GND (TP3): 3.23-3.37V again. ("On within about 5 ms" is a SCOPE check only - a meter can't see it; on the meter just check 3.23-3.37V.) Remount and write say OK above. No reset. 3V3Q (TP8) min-hold: less than 0.1V below its idle reading |

## `bp2_27_12v` - 27 — the 12V sense (Rev Q), using the firmware's own driver (GPIO8, ADC1, 12 dB,

> Bench PSU into J1 through the 4A fuse. Meter 12V (TP6) to GND (TP7).
> 1. PSU at 12.0V. When the readings settle, type  cal <meter volts>  e.g.  cal 12.03
>    RECORD the scale factor it prints (build log; it then goes into include/board.h).
> 2. PSU at 11.0V. The 'volts' reading must be within 0.1V of the meter. Then back to 12.0V: the same.
> Switches nothing.

## `bp2_28_sensors` - 28 — the sensors and the spare channels (Rev Q).

> 1. All six sensors on J3-J8 (channels 0-5, by their roles): every serial on its own channel, CRC good.
> 2. Move one sensor to J17: it reads on channel 6 (its old channel now empty).
> 3. Move it on to J18: channel 7. Then back to its own connector.
> Switches nothing. Record: which serial on which channel, and any CRC failure.

## `bp2_29_lcd_touch` - 29 — the LCD and touch (Rev Q), using the firmware's own LCD, touch, backlight and

> The LCD on J20 with its 30 cm ribbon (test 10 passed). Nothing else needed.
> At boot the LCD is cleared to black with the backlight OFF (as the firmware does at boot).
> Steps: bars at 15 MHz; bars at 20 MHz (trial); touch; backlight dimming; GPIO48 reset; I2C1 scan;
> the landscape check (UP arrow, four corners; a / b switch the landscape way).

| # | Step | Check now |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1. Colour bars at 15 MHz, backlight 100% | Eight bars, left to right: white, yellow, cyan, green, magenta, red, blue, black. No tearing, no noise. Note if the order is mirrored or the colours inverted (Claude adjusts the start-up commands) |
| 2 | 2. Colour bars at 20 MHz (a TRIAL only: the cabinet runs 15 MHz) | The same bars, redrawn at 20 MHz: clean, or noise / wrong colours? Record it (trial only) |
| 3 | 3. Touch: coordinates while a finger is down | Touch the screen: x,y print while touched. Top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right corners: record roughly what each prints. The numbers follow the finger |
| 4 | 4. Backlight 100% -> 10% | The backlight steps down every second from 100% to 10% and stays there: it visibly dims |
| 5 | 5. GPIO48 pulsed: LCD and touch reset together | Above: with GPIO48 held low the touch controller does NOT answer (it is in reset); the screen goes black and the bars come back; then 'touch answers again'. Touch the screen: coordinates print |
| 6 | 6. I2C1 scan and RTC read; then everything idle | The scan finds 0x38 (touch) and 0x68 (RTC); the RTC time prints. Now idle: meter I2C1 SDA and SCL at R69 and R70 to GND (TP3): each about 3.3V - NOT 5V |
| 7 | 7. Landscape check: UP arrow, a touch in each corner (a / b = the two landscape ways) | Landscape A first. The arrow points to the top of the screen and the word UP is above it. Touch each corner target in turn: each prints 'corner: top left' etc. for the corner you touched, and its target turns green. Type b for landscape B (turned 180 degrees), a for A again; do the four corners in each. CHOOSE the way that is up as the LCD sits in the enclosure, and RECORD it (A or B) for the build log |

## `bp2_30_rtc` - 30 — the RTC cell (Rev Q), using the firmware's own I2C and WiFi/NTP drivers.

> Day 1: when 'NTP synced' shows, type  sync  (the DS3231 set from NTP, OSF cleared).
> Leave the board powered 48 hours (the cell charges from 3V3Q).
> After 48 h: meter BT1's + tab to GND (TP3): 2.8-3.2V. RECORD it with the date and 3V3Q (TP8).
>   (above 3.2V: 1M across C49, 3A.8 - tell Claude)
> Then 12V off overnight. Next morning, 12V on: this sketch prints OSF (must be CLEAR) and,
> once NTP syncs, the DS3231's difference from NTP (time kept: within a few seconds).
> Switches nothing. WiFi: the home network, for NTP only.

*No step list: commands as in the banner.*

## `bp2_35_bulb` - 35 — the bulb surge (Rev Q). USB OUT; the J23 monitor may stay on.

> USB-C OUT (the native USB unplugged). The J23 monitor cable may stay on (GND, TX, RX only).
> The 21W 12V bulb on J10 pins 3-4 (KSD in series optional for the bulb). An SD card in J22 for the log.
> After g: K1 energised; the bulb ON 2 s, OFF 3 s, 50 times. Watch for a freeze or a reset.
> RUN IT TWICE (BP2 test 35):
>   Run 1: as it starts - hardware watchdog PAUSED (GPIO1 an input), so a freeze shows as a freeze. Type g.
>   Run 2: afterwards, type  hwdog on  then  g  - the watchdog toggling every pass, as the firmware runs.
>   (A reset during run 2 restarts with the watchdog paused: type  hwdog on  again, then  g .)
> A freeze: the count stops and nothing answers - switch the 12V off and on, then check the card.
> If the board resets, this banner prints again: type g and it carries on from the cycle it reached.
> Afterwards, the card on the Mac:  python3 tools/check_logs.py /Volumes/WINEADOR --bulb

*No step list: commands as in the banner.*
